config.vanilla-outsider-bed-chat-hider.s: Removes the dark sleeping overlay when resting in a bed. (Note: True Sleep takes priority if installed).
config.vanilla-outsider-bed-chat-hider.a: Automatically hide the chat overlay upon entering a bed.
config.vanilla-outsider-bed-chat-hider.e: Gradually fades out bed buttons and chat input while resting in bed if idle.
config.vanilla-outsider-bed-chat-hider.c: Seconds of idle stillness before bed UI elements begin fading out.
config.vanilla-outsider-bed-chat-hider.f: Also hides the center crosshair when sleep HUD elements fade out.
